summary: preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute a 700 KB obfuscated payload smuggled outside the files manifest
details: package.json declares preinstall: `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime binary from the oven-sh/bun GitHub release archive, extracts it into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js via execFileSync. math_init.js is a ~700 KB heavily obfuscated JavaScript bundle (rotating string-array shuffle function, hex-named identifiers). Neither setup.mjs nor math_init.js is listed in the package.json `files` manifest (`["index.js","CHANGELOG.md","README.md"]`), yet both are present at the tarball root and are auto-executed on `npm install`. An SVG transformer has no functional reason to fetch a second language runtime at install time and execute an obfuscated bundle unrelated to its advertised transformer surface; the Bun path also bypasses tooling that inspects only Node-resolved code. The obfuscated payload runs unconditionally on every installer machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
